description: FK tới Security Trading Snapshot Dimension
etl_logic: LOOKUP security_trading_snpst_dim ON security_trading_snpst_dim.symbol = market_price_snapshot.symbol WHERE market_price_snapshot.src_stm_code = 'MDDS_JAD_TRADINGVIEWHISTORY1DAY'

description: FK tới Calendar Date Dimension theo ngày giao dịch của nến ngày
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = market_price_snapshot.trading_dt AND market_price_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date AND market_price_snapshot.src_stm_code = 'MDDS_JAD_TRADINGVIEWHISTORY1DAY'
